claim: After an HA restart, MQTT sensors discovered by a non-retained discovery message became unavailable and stayed broken until the user deleted the entity and resent the discovery message — HA did not itself re-request or persist discovery.
stance_target: ha-linux-agent must republish discovery (retained or on reconnect/HA-birth) or entities die on every HA restart
scope_conditions: HA 0.114.0b0/b2 (Aug 2020), broker on separate machine, Tasmota devices
quoted_support: A lot of my MQTT sensors are unavailable after a restart. The solution to get them back is to delete the entity, and resend the discovery message.

claim: HA issue #38661 was closed with milestone 0.114.0 and assigned to emontnemery, cross-referenced to #38876 — i.e. the restart-recovery problem was treated as a real HA defect and fixed in the 0.114.0 line, establishing that restart recovery of MQTT entities is a maintained HA behaviour.
stance_target: modern HA handles rediscovery races better, but the device-side republish contract remains the reliable baseline
